_readme: Persistent fetch-failure ledger for the Las Azules S2 media sweep routine. Sweeps must read this before attempting any body fetch on a candidate URL and skip anything currently in cooldown, rendering the skip on the sweep evidence line. failCount tracks consecutive full fallback-chain failures (WebFetch AND Firecrawl scrape both failed in the same attempt). Three consecutive full-chain failures sets cooldownUntil to 30 days out. After cooldown expires, the URL gets one retry (WebFetch then Firecrawl); success resets failCount to 0 and clears cooldownUntil, failure restarts the 30-day cooldown. A separate category, permanentSkip with a skipReason, marks URLs that are fetchable but excluded for an editorial reason (for example a syndicated republication of a story already in data.json under a primary outlet). permanentSkip entries are skipped regardless of cooldownUntil and must never be treated as, or logged as, a fetch failure. See LEMA-9620 for origin, LEMA-9619 for the incident that motivated this file, and LEMA-9621 for the permanentSkip category.
